description: A man staying at a secluded historical mansion finds himself being haunted by the presence of a specter.

title: Maniac
description: Childhood abuse triggers a man (Joe Spinell) to kill women and use their scalps to dress his mannequins.

title: Body Bags
description: Filmmaker John Carpenter introduces a trio of terror tales: "Unleaded," "Hair" and Tobe Hooper's "Baseball Man."

title: Movie Tron: Path of Blood
description: On October 31, 1994, an all-night movie marathon aired in Barrington Colo., beginning with "Path of Blood", a '70s era chanbara samurai film. The broadcast offers clues into the mysterious tragedy that befell the town.

title: Bloody Bites
description:
S18 E05 — Wild Animal
In the early hours of the morning, Mallory, a wealthy woman, finds an abandoned baby; she drives the baby to a caravan park and abandons it there to be found by someone else; however, she feels like the child's mother is stalking her.

title: The Island
description:
S01 E01 — Arrivals
A ghost ship carrying a deadly virus runs aground on Sløborn in the North Sea, but the islanders remain unaware of the danger.

title: The Island
description:
S01 E02 — Host
The situation escalates when Evelin fails to abort her unborn child; the boys who discovered and looted the ghost ship spread the virus all over the island without knowing it.

title: Tales From The Void
description:
S01 E04 — Carry
Katie is thrilled when she learns she's pregnant, fulfilling her lifelong dream of becoming a mother; when she learns her unborn child isn't viable, she finds that termination is not in line with her religious community's expectations.

title: The Trouble With Tessa
description:
S01 E04 — Part Four: Heir
Tessa returns to find that someone has taken the tapes; as strange noises rise from the basement, a surprise visit from Betsy changes everything.

title: The Beyond
description: Gruesome deaths occur when a woman (Katherine MacColl) inherits a hotel that is one of seven gateways to hell.

title: Bloodsuckers and the Grimoire
description: Oliver grew up believing his father died when he was a toddler. But as college ends and life threatens to pull him into the ordinary, a brutal truth emerges -- that his father has just died and left him a remote cabin full of secrets.

title: St. Agatha
description: Pregnant and on the run, young Mary seeks refuge in an isolated convent in small-town Georgia in the 1950s. When she discovers the community's dark secrets, Mary must find a way to save herself and her baby before she's trapped there forever.

description: A possessed turkey terrorizes five college students during Thanksgiving break.

description: Neurotic astronauts (Edward Albert, Erin Moran, Ray Walston) face a giant worm and other monsters on a distant planet.

description: A space ranger (Jesse Vint) lands at a research station where a flesh-eating mutant is loose.

title: Auntie Lee's Meat Pies
description: A devil-worshiping woman sends out her four beautiful nieces to find young men, who are lured back to her place so they can be killed, ground up, and sold as meat pies.

title: Howling III
description: An Australian scientist (Barry Otto) finds marsupial werewolves, one of whom (Imogen Annesley) finds work in a horror movie.
